item.title: Meaning
item.description:
What is meaning

One of the greatest questions one can ask themselves is ‘What is my meaning’. From evolution’s perspective everything exists to reproduce, however humans are self aware so are able to find their meaning for themselves. I believe that meaning comes from engaging with the world around you: challenging yourself, exploring the world, contributing to something bigger than ourselves. Humanity considering its flaws is able to grow and adapt, so being human is the ability to be curious and open to change.

item.title: Meditations by Marcus Aurelius
item.description:
Meditations was written by the Roman emperor Marcus Aurelius without any intention of publication. The Meditations offer a collection of challenging spiritual reflections and exercises developed as the emperor struggled to understand himself and make sense of the universe.

Below I have written about certain sections that have really spoken to me

6.54

That which is not good for the swarm, neither is it good for the bee.

To me this represents the constraints of society, where we as a race constantly do things that will not benefit others. We are digging ourselves into a hole that will soon be inescapable. He could be referring to how how can a person be good when society is bad to them. This could reveal how society has been set up to oppress the common folk.
